insights.one_liner: London-based European private equity firm that has raised over €20 billion since 1989; its Amsterdam internship requires Dutch.

culture.text: About 329 staff, headquartered in London, investing in the Benelux, DACH, France, the Nordics and the UK.
Staff come from schools like HEC Paris, Stockholm School of Economics, ESCP, St. Gallen and LSE, mostly in finance and economics.

open.text: Its open finance internship in Amsterdam requires Dutch.
Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: Has raised more than €20 billion and invested in over 200 European companies since 1989.
Sold German smart-building maker MDT technologies to Bregal Unternehmerkapital.
Its Dutch portfolio company Qconcepts made a third acquisition under IK.
